text: They are in Babylon and they're saying, "I am struggling so much. I pledge my loyalty to Jerusalem, even though I'm in Babylon." And it says, "If I forget you, Jerusalem, in my right hand, forget its skill. Meaning, I shouldn't be able to even play my instrument and my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, that I won't be able to sing. If I don't praise you, I don't want to sing at all." Is what he's saying. Okay, now the end of the psalm is.
